method: Read-only remote protocol/bound-input/source hashes, process metadata and project du; local exact Git bytes and prior native2 receipt comparison. No GPU/test/simulation run or waiting for completion.

recipe.prior_estimate_scope: Separately run identity branch; no exact prefix equality or actual successor claim

ownership_review.live_context: post_assimilation_selection.search builds controls, state, accepted V, history, full merit evaluator and reference from the CURRENT live context. The prior archive supplies fixed successor policy only.
ownership_review.registration: confirm_2 state is owned, then registration occurs only after run_search returns with confirmed and unchanged binding; no extra candidate replay.
ownership_review.remaining_gate: Actual successor preparation may differ from the prior estimate. Branch acceptance requires later actual health, closure, raw supply/shape, prepared constraints and common-cohort motion checks; none evaluated by this preflight.

budget.scope: Point-in-time conservative budget includes another full12GB even though current output is already counted. Not a guarantee against unrelated future writes; root remains runtime monitor.
budget.enforcement: Bound ops mode checks project used+12GB<100GB before launch; capture prewrite reserves65,536 failure bytes within12GB.

limitations: Preflight only: no candidate search success, outer commit, actual successor fidelity, later quality, per-particle rest, holes or4K conclusion.
Identical config and assets do not imply the separately run estimate has the same prefix or actual successor; the protocol explicitly treats it as an estimate.
Live process/source identity was checked at collection only; final run bindings and output artifacts remain to be audited.
No native finite-difference, external binary/library hash, or independent GPU replay performed.
